events.title: Pre-NextFest Update
events.summary: Gameplay:Melvin has a new hip thrust attack. Watch out.UI:The pause menu is a lot nicer looking and easier to use now.Settings menu has been overhauled. It works in the pause menu now too!In game notifications look better than ever.Key rebinding is easier and more comprehensive now.Player HUD has been refreshed and spruced up visually.The Main Menu has been refurbished.Some menus have had their buttons hold requirements removed or lessened.

(you think it's a joke, but it works).Added liquor, beer, and wine bottles to the editor, for your drinking pleasure. Take that, ESRB. events.title: Custom Hobo Update v0.4.0
events.summary: It's time for the spring Custom Hobo update! We've been hard at work preparing for the upcoming NextFest and are excited to share these patch notes with you. Gameplay:All hobos have learned how to wall jump.The global slow-motion button has been removed. While powerful, we found it confused new players and disrupted co-op gameplay. events.title: Custom Hobo live on the Steam Store!
events.summary: We are thrilled to announce the Custom Hobo is on the Steam store. Wishlist it now!The game is nearly feature complete. We are spending most of our time polishing content, adding deeper progression, and integrating the Level Editor with the Steam Workshop.Feel free to reach out to the dev team on our discord if you wish to become an early Beta Tester!
